auth.forgotPassword.title: Wakanganwa password?
auth.forgotPassword.subtitle: Usazvidya mwoyo. Pinda kero yako yeemail uye tichakutumira chinongedzo chekudzorera.

auth.forgotPassword.helpAlertMessage: Chikwata chedu chokutsigira chichadzoka kwauri nokukurumidza.
anonymous.mode.activeSubtitle: Nhoroondo yako inoramba isina kubatana neunhu hwako kana nzira iyi iri kushanda.

anonymous.limitations.subtitle: Mukati meanonymized mode, zvimwe zvinhu zvine chokuita neakaundi zvichange zvisingabvumirwi kana kuti zvisingawanikwi.

anonymous.limitations.syncText: Mamwe mashoko angave asingawirirani pakati pemamwe madhivhizheni ako.
anonymous.limitations.communicationsText: AWA haizokwanisi kukutumirai maemail ane chokuita neakaundi yenyu isina kuzivikanwa.
anonymous.limitations.securityText: Tinokurudzira kubvumira kodhi yePIN kana biometrics kuchengetedza kupinda kuAWA.
anonymous.limitations.acknowledgeLabel: Ndinonzwisisa kuti nzira isina kuzivikanwa inoshanda sei.
